title: Viva Glint: Rewrite with Copilot for survey comments
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, off-by-default access, licensing and privacy statements are supported by Microsoft's published text. The checklist names the Survey Taking access setting without a corresponding controls-table row; this is a minor completeness finding, not an incorrect navigation path.

claims.claim: Rewrite with Copilot only rewrites comments the survey taker originally wrote, rather than writing comments for them.

claims.quote: When composing a survey comment, users can leverage Copilot to generate alternative phrasing that improves clarity, conciseness, or tone.

claims.claim: The feature can adjust the comment's tone.
claims.quote: Adjust tone (for example, more professional or more casual)

claims.claim: The survey taker chooses whether to accept a suggested rewrite.
claims.quote: Users decide whether to use Copilot in Glint and whether to accept the suggested rewritten comments.

claims.claim: The default state is admin-opt-in: the setting starts off and survey takers need administrator enablement.

claims.claim: Survey Taking access can be managed independently of the existing Copilot in Viva Glint setting.
claims.quote: Yes. A new setting controls the feature, and you can manage it independently from the existing Copilot in Viva Glint setting in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: Glint reports and exports do not identify rewritten comments, so survey owners cannot separate them through those outputs.
claims.quote: No. Survey reports and exports don't show whether Copilot was used to rewrite a survey taker's original comment.

claims.claim: Copilot temporarily uses the original comment text to generate rewrite suggestions.
claims.quote: This feature temporarily uses the original text to generate rewritten suggestions.

claims.claim: The original text used for rewriting is not retained after submission of the rewritten survey response.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Unaccepted rewrite suggestions are not saved as survey data.
claims.quote: Unaccepted suggestions aren't saved as part of the survey data. Only the final submitted comments are saved as part of survey results.

claims.claim: Copilot-assisted commenting interactions are not used to train generative AI foundation models.
claims.quote: These Copilot-assisted interactions aren't used to train any generative AI foundation models.

claims.claim: Microsoft states that Copilot in Viva Glint features process raw responses, prompts and respondent attributes within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.
claims.quote: When using Copilot in Viva Glint features (such as comment summarization in Copilot in Viva Glint), raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes are processed entirely within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.

claims.claim: Copilot in Viva Glint uses Microsoft-hosted models provided through Azure OpenAI Service.
claims.quote: Copilot in Viva Glint uses Microsoft-hosted large language models provided through Azure OpenAI Service.

claims.claim: Microsoft says LLM processing is aligned with Viva Glint's data-residency commitments for the tenant region.
claims.quote: When Copilot in Viva Glint calls Microsoft-hosted large language models to process raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes, processing is aligned with Viva Glint's data residency commitments for your tenant's region.

claims.claim: Copilot in Viva Glint is unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users irrespective of org-wide or custom policies.
